english_text: Your selves are among other selves.
Your traditions are among other traditions.
Your graves are among other graves.
But how gracious your names are!
How noble your souls are!
How superior your affairs are!
How majestic your stations are!
How dependable your covenants are!
How truthful your promises are!
Your words are illumination.
Your affairs are (leading to) orthodoxy.
Your precepts are piety.
Your deeds are all good.
Your habits are charity.
Your nature is generosity.

transliteration: wa sh'anukumu al-ḥaqq. wa al-ṣidqu wa al-rifq.
english_text: Your issue is truth, honesty, and lenience.
Your words are judgments and decisiveness.

transliteration: wa ra'iyukum 'ilmun wa ḥilmun wa ḥazmun.
english_text: Your views are (based upon) knowledge, temperance, and forethought.

arabic_text: إِنْ ذُكِرَ ٱلْخَيْرُ كُنْتُمْ أَوَّلَهُ وَأَصْلَهُ وَفَرْعَهُ وَمَعْدِنَهُ وَمَأْوَاهُ وَمُنْتَهَاهُ
transliteration: 'in dhukira al-khayru kuntum awwalahu. wa-aslahu wa-farʿahu. wa maʿdinahu wa maʾwahu wa muntahahu
english_text: Whenever goodness is mentioned, you are its initiation, origin, branch, essence, center, and ultimate.
May my father, mother, and soul be ransoms for you.

arabic_text: كَيْفَ أَصِفُ حُسْنَ ثَنَائِكُمْ وَأُحْصِي جَمِيلَ بَلاَئِكُمْ
transliteration: kaifa ʾaṣifu ḥusna thanāʾikum. wa 'uhsii jamilaa balaa'ikum.
english_text: How shall I describe the excellence of your merits and define the beauty of your conferrals?

arabic_text: وَبِكُمْ أَخْرَجَنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ وَفَرَّجَ عَنَّا غَمَرَاتِ ٱلْكُرُوبِ وَأَنْقَذَنَا مِنْ شَفَا جُرُفِ ٱلْهَلَكَاتِ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: wa bikum akhrajana allah mina aldhulli. wa farrajana ghamarāti al-kurūb. wa-anqaḏanā min shafā jurufi al-halakāt. wa mina al-nār.
english_text: It is on account of you that Allah has pulled us out of degradation, removed from us the clutches of hardships, and saved us from the brink of the pit of perditions and from the Fire.

transliteration: bi-abi antum wa ummi wa nafsi.
english_text: May my father, mother, and soul be ransoms for you.

arabic_text: بِمُوَالاَتِكُمْ عَلَّمَنَا ٱللَّهُ مَعَالِمَ دِينِنَا وَأَصْلَحَ مَاكَانَ فَسَدَ مِنْ دُنْيَانَا
transliteration: bi muwālātikum 'allamana allāhu ma'ālima dīninā. wa aslah ma kana fasada min dunyana.
english_text: Through our loyalty to your leadership, Allah has taught us the features of our religion and has set aright the spoiled items of our worldly lives.

arabic_text: وَبِمُوَالاَتِكُمْ تَمَّتِ ٱلْكَلِمَةُ وَعَظُمَتِ ٱلنِّعْمَةُ وَائْتَلَفَتِ ٱلْفُرْقَةُ
transliteration: wa bi-muwālātikum tammat al-kalimah. wa ʿadhumat in-niʿmah. wa-aitalafatil-firqatu
english_text: Through our loyalty to your leadership, the Word has been perfected, the grace has become great, and the discord has turned into alliance.
Through our loyalty to your leadership, the obligatory obedience (to Allah) is accepted.

arabic_text: وَلَكُمُ ٱلْمَوَدَّةُ ٱلْوَاجِبَةُ وَٱلدَّرَجَاتُ ٱلرَّفِيعَةُ وَٱلْمَقَامُ ٱلْمَحْمُودُ وَٱلْمَكَانُ ٱلْمَعْلُومُ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
transliteration: walakumu al-mawaddah al-wajibah wa al-darajaat al-rafi'ah. wa al-maqāmu al-mahmūdu wal-makānu al-maʿlūmu ʿinda l-lāhi ʿazza wa-jalla.
english_text: To you alone are the obligatory affection, the elevated ranks, the praiseworthy standing, the renowned station with Allah the Almighty and All-majestic,

arabic_text: وَٱلْجَاهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ وَٱلشَّأْنُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ وَٱلشَّفَاعَةُ ٱلْمَقْبُولَةُ
transliteration: wa-l-jāhu al-ʿaẓīm. wa al-shaʾnu al-kabīr. wal-shafāʿatu al-maqbulah.
english_text: the topmost prestige, the supreme station, and the admitted intercession.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ
transliteration: rabbanaa aamannaa bimaa anzalta. wa-ttabaʿna ar-rasul.
english_text: O our Lord, we believe in that which You have sent down and we follow the Messenger;
so, write our names among those who bear witness.
